newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia satisfied with PLO-Isreal deal on Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Russia satisfied with PLO-Isreal deal on Hebron.

text.p: Russia expressed satisfaction on Thursday with the Israeli-PLO peace deal on Hebron and hoped it would increase trust and mutual understanding in the region.

The foreign ministry said in a statement that Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov had sent letters of congratulations to Palestinian, Israeli, Jordanian and United Nations officials following Wednesday's deal.

"Such a result was achieved thanks to energetic support and encouragement by Russia, the United States, Egypt, Jordan, the European Union and other members of the international community," Primakov said.
He expressd hope that the agreement would increase the "mutual understanding and trust needed for further progress" in settling disputes in the region.
Wednesday's agreement was to launch PLO self-rule in the West Bank town of Hebron and redeploy Israeli troops in West Bank rural areas.
